hints.title: Two-Tier Frequency and Recency Eviction
hints.text: Eviction must prioritize keys with the least access frequency, breaking ties by evicting the least recently used key among that frequency bracket.

hints.title: Frequency Buckets with Recency Ordering
hints.text: Map each key to its value and current access count. Map each frequency count to an ordered sequence of keys. Track the minimum active frequency.

hints.title: LFU Cache Lifecycle Blueprint
hints.text: Maintain key_to_val_freq and freq_to_keys (OrderedDict). On get(key): bump frequency, move key from old freq bucket to freq+1 bucket. If old freq bucket empty and was min_freq, increment min_freq. On put(key, val): if key exists, update value and bump freq; else if at capacity, pop oldest key from min_freq bucket and delete; insert key with freq 1 and set min_freq = 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: All get and put calls execute in strict O(1) time using hash tables and doubly-linked bucket nodes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining a min-heap over frequency scores requires O(log C) per access.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual dictionary mapping maintains recency order and min-frequency pointers concurrently.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly resetting min_freq to 1 upon inserting a brand new key.
